name: Internet & cloud outages
value: No cloud/payments outage; Delta IT 22 Nov
summary: No major cloud, CDN or payments outage over 2h found to 24 Nov; a Delta airline IT failure on 22 Nov was fixed that day
state: Delta's automated weight-and-balance system failed on the morning of 22 Nov, prompting a brief ground stop at Atlanta and manual workarounds; it was restored that afternoon after about 1,800 delays system-wide, and the FAA said its own systems were not at fault (Bloomberg via Spokesman-Review; Latin Times). That was one airline's own system, not a cloud, CDN or payments service. Searches to 24 Nov found no such outage over 2h in the past 48h, so Normal holds.
for_you: Air passengers in the US can check their airline's flight status before travelling. Delays from the 22 Nov Delta failure have cleared.
rubric_hit: Normal: no cloud/CDN/payments outage over 2h in the past 48h; Delta's 22 Nov failure was airline-specific

sources.title: Spokesman-Review (Bloomberg) — Delta tech outage triggers delays and halts at Atlanta hub
Latin Times — Delta recovers from weight-system crash that delayed 1,800 nationwide flights

why: A handful of cloud and CDN providers carry much of the internet; one bad update can halt airlines, banks and payments.
drivers: Software updates, configuration errors, attacks, power failures.

rubric.alert: Multi-hour global outage hitting payments, airlines or emergency services, ongoing or within 24h.
rubric.watch: A major cloud/CDN/payments outage > 2h in the past 48h.
rubric.normal: No major multi-hour outages in the past 48h.
